messages:
maria_acme: Hi team — we claimed the GCP Accelerator credits yesterday but nothing landed in our Redwood account. Console shows zero balance and the marketplace shows the grant succeeded. Help?

samir: Sorry to hear that. Can you share the entitlement ID and the Redwood org/account id? Also a screenshot of the GCP marketplace confirmation if possible.

maria_acme: Entitlement ID: GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072. Redwood account: acme-prod-42. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/gcp-accel-confirm.png

jenna: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) Did you use a different billing account/org than usual? 2) Can you try the marketplace entitlement lookup API and paste the response? e.g., curl https://marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/entitlements/GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072

maria_acme: We did migrate projects between orgs last month but billing stayed the same AFAIK. Ran the curl and got a 404 with body: {"error":"entitlement_not_found"}.

samir: Hm. 404 means the entitlement didn't map to a Redwood account in our index. I'll check the webhook delivery & entitlement sync. @billing-bot can you show last webhook attempts for that entitlement id?

billing-bot: webhook_attempts: [ {"id":"wh_7731","entitlement":"GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072","status":"delivered","received_at":"1968003320"}, {"id":"wh_7732","entitlement":"GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072","status":"processed_error","received_at":"1968003330","error":"org_lookup_failed"} ]

samir: Ok saw mixed delivery states. The processor errored due to org lookup returning null for the cloud_billing_account field. Posting sanitized processor log snippet: ```INFO processor=entitlement-sync id=GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072 received_from=wh_7731; lookup_org(billing_account: null) -> error: OrgNotFound```

aditya: Looping in eng-billing. From experience this often happens when the customer's marketplace grant references a GCP billingAccount that doesn't match the org mapping table after org/project renames/migrations. We have a safe reapply API we can run once we confirm identity.

jenna: @maria_acme can you confirm the GCP billing account id (format: 012345-678901-234567)? Also can you confirm the exact GCP project id used in the marketplace purchase?

maria_acme: Billing account: 012345-678901-234567. Project: acme-ml-prod.

aditya: Thanks. I'll run a targeted reapply. Internal command (sanitized): ```POST /internal/v1/entitlements/reapply { "entitlement_id": "GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072", "billing_account": "012345-678901-234567", "redwood_account": "acme-prod-42", "trigger": "support_manual_reapply" }``` This will force remapping from the webhook payload into our entitlement index and trigger credit allocation.

samir: Executing now. Will keep logs here.

ops-bot: action_started: reapply_entitlement GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072 by samir at 1968003620

samir: Reapply returned 200 but with warning: {"status":"applied_with_warnings","warnings":["billing_account_alias_mismatch"]}. Running final allocate-credits job.

billing-bot: allocate_job: {"job_id":"alloc_992","entitlement":"GCP-ACCEL-2026-0072","status":"completed","credits_allocated_cents":500000} 

samir: Allocation completed and I can now see +$5,000 credit on acme-prod-42 in the Redwood console. Maria can you confirm you see credits?

maria_acme: I see the credits now, thank you!! :tada: Any reason this happened so we can avoid it?

aditya: Root cause looks like the entitlement webhook included an old billing_account alias that didn't match the canonical billing_account id we store after the org migration. Processor treated it as unmatched and error'd. Short-term: manual reapply fixes it. Long-term: we'll add an alias resolution step and retry/backfill for recent migrations.

jenna: Filed ENG-BILL-482: "Entitlement processor: alias resolution for billing account mismatches". Tagging for follow-up and add to postmortem if similar cases >1 in the last 30d.

samir: Closing the customer-facing loop now. Maria, we'll follow up with a short writeup and ETA on the fix.

maria_acme: Appreciate it, thanks everyone! :pray:
